about_the_game:
■ Store Description

 Stranded travelers after a planet collision. But... the pirate ship is collapsing! The only way out is their secret weapon, 'Omega'! Three travelers have just two hours to escape from a collapsing pirate ship after an unexpected collision.

"Only one of the three can become powerful!" ZENITH's precision, VULCAN's firepower, RUSTY's defense. This is a strategic co-op roguelite action where you transfer power in real-time—your judgment decides the team's survival.

■ Detailed Description

《OMEGA PROTOCOL》is a 3-player cooperative rogue-lite action game.

  • Your team, crash-landed on a pirate ship after a planet collision, must now escape from the collapsing vessel. The only way out is the 'Omega' core you've discovered, but there's a catch: only one can use it! To survive, you must strategically use this power to clear a path.

Core Features:

  • Real-time Booster Switching: Decide who gets enhanced each moment. Cooperation clashes with survival instinct.

  • Brand Philosophy System: ZENITH precision, VULCAN firepower, RUSTY defense—each ideology dominates combat differently.

  • Rogue-lite Dungeons: Every run brings new stages and unpredictable enemies.

  • Strategic Cooperation: Perfect teamwork is the answer. But sometimes perfect selfishness is also the answer.

One choice creates heroes, another demands sacrifice. Who lives, and who becomes powerful?

Demo Version:

  • The demo version consists of 5 stage in total.

  • There are 3 types of players and 18 skills.

  • There are 6 types of small enemies and 3 types of named enemies.

  • You can Upgrade Skill and Stats by Items 

  • Discover over 10 unique items that allow you to enhance your stats, upgrade your skills, and customize your build.

  • Bosses, additional stages, and builds will be added continuously.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1903)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: "Choose, boost, survive!" Rogue-lite Co-op Action!! 3 rookies vs mutants with ONE shared power-up. Survive together by passing boost between teammates! Sniper needs precision? Give it! Tank under attack? Switch instantly! Steal power from allies or sacrifice yourself. Teamwork meets betrayal.
